rows.grounds: compound of sarva, ākāra, and samāpatti; subject denoting coalescence with all forms
fused form of anantā and emphatic eva; qualifies the attainment as without limit
verb expressing the manifestation of the attainment

items.question: To what extent does the attainment of all forms arise?
premises: Attainment of all forms is such a manifestation.
No limiting condition restricts this attainment.
items.inference: Therefore the attainment of all forms arises as infinite.
items.plain_english: The attainment of all forms arises as truly infinite.
